#   bank IS the SSF2/SSF2T arrangement (3DO SSF2T BGM = the unlooped stereo
#   masters HSF2 AE carries).  So this is a RE-KEY of the HSF2 arrange ADX

#     slots; trace/sweep.lua) -> per-command clips in the internal listening archive/
#     ssf2_arcade_id/.  Each clip cross-correlated (log-RMS envelope NCC)
#     against the LABELLED HSF2 CPS2-bank recordings (entry 71=Ken .. 86=Dee-Jay
#     = the same QSound masters ssf2 emits): cmd 0x01..0x10 identify as the 16
#     SF2 characters in EXACT HSF2 order, NCC 0.79-0.98, margin +0.17..+0.67 to
#     2nd place.  Commands >=0x11 are noise-grade vs every stage ref (menu / vs /
#     select / SFX / voice — they pass through to real QSound untouched).
#   * IN-GAME ANCHOR: drove `ssf2` into a real match (Ryu vs Dee-Jay on Dee-Jay's
#     beach stage, on-screen snapshot); the game issued kind=0 stage BGM cmd
#     0x10 at stage start — matching the sound-test id 0x10=Dee-Jay.  Confirms
#     sound-test command == in-game command for this standalone driver (1.04).
# JOIN: arrange_entry = HSF2 arrange afs_entry for the same character.  For the
#   16 SF2 stages the HSF2 arrange entry index EQUALS the standalone stage
#   command (both are Ken-first order): cmd 0xNN -> arrange entry NN.
# ssf2 has 16 stage themes (no Gouki/Akuma — that is a Turbo addition).
